description: This Java source file defines the class `ExpressCheckoutEvents`, which manages PayPal Express Checkout integration within the OFBiz eCommerce framework. It includes methods for setting up checkout, redirecting, updating checkout status, retrieving checkout details, handling the checkout process, and canceling checkout sessions. The class uses various OFBiz utilities, entity queries, and service calls to facilitate communication with PayPal and manage checkout flow.

classes.name: ExpressCheckoutEvents
classes.description: Main class handling PayPal Express Checkout operations, including initiating checkout, redirects, updates, retrieving checkout details, and canceling.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initiates the Express Checkout process by calling the appropriate PayPal service based on checkout type.

methods.name: expressCheckoutRedirect
methods.description: Redirects user to PayPal for Express Checkout using the stored token.

methods.name: expressCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates the checkout session during the process, typically to handle PayPal responses.

methods.name: getExpressCheckoutDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details from PayPal about the current express checkout session.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes the Express Checkout process, performing the appropriate service call.

methods.name: expressCheckoutCancel
methods.description: Cancels the PayPal express checkout by removing the session token.

methods.name: determineCheckoutType
methods.description: Determines whether the checkout is PAYFLOW, STANDARD, or NONE based on store configuration.
